wands.careerLine: In work, the fire of drive, of starting a venture or a project, of competition, is lit.
wands.moneyLine: In money, ideas for income surface, but impulsive spending needs watching.
wands.growthLine: For inner growth, you need practice in acknowledging what you want before you acknowledge the fear.

cups.label: Cups
cups.symbolLine: Cups reflect the ripples of the heart, attachment, and the warmth of kind exchange.
cups.uprightLine: Upright, the flow of feeling comes alive and two hearts touch gently.
cups.reversedLine: Reversed, feeling pools or overflows, and misunderstanding and dependence need clearing.
cups.loveLine: In love, the depth of giving and receiving the heart is what matters.
cups.relationshipLine: In relationships, empathy and care are what restore the flow.
cups.careerLine: In work, a sense for people, care, artistry, and a feel for collaboration all come alive.
cups.moneyLine: In money, mood-led spending and emotional choices need a calm look.
cups.growthLine: For inner growth, you learn to let your feelings pass through safely without being ashamed of them.

swords.label: Swords
swords.symbolLine: Swords light the keen air in which words and thoughts divide a situation.
swords.uprightLine: Upright, checking the facts and judging honestly is what puts the flow in order.
swords.reversedLine: Reversed, slow down so the thinking does not overheat and the words do not stay as wounds.
swords.loveLine: In love, the precision of your words and manner shows before the heart does.
swords.relationshipLine: In relationships, you need conversation that reduces misreading, and boundaries that are clear.
swords.careerLine: In work, the power of analysis, strategy, documentation and decision is what counts.
swords.moneyLine: In money, reading the numbers and the terms coolly is what keeps the losses down.
swords.growthLine: For inner growth, you come to tell whether your thinking is a tool that guards you or a blade that cuts you.

pentacles.label: Pentacles
pentacles.symbolLine: Pentacles reflect the conditions you can hold in your hand and the weight of a reality that piles up slowly.
pentacles.uprightLine: Upright, you can put in the time and build stability and results.
pentacles.reversedLine: Reversed, look at the practical burden or the delay, and lay the groundwork again.
pentacles.loveLine: In love, trust and a settled daily life are what matter.
pentacles.relationshipLine: In relationships, the attitude you have kept up steadily carries more weight than words.
pentacles.careerLine: In work, hands-on practice, results, accumulated skill and long-range plans take the centre.
pentacles.moneyLine: In money, practical structure — managing, saving, having criteria for investing — is what guards your luck.
pentacles.growthLine: For inner growth, you come to build habits that actually change your life, however slowly.

1.scene: Like a seed that has just settled onto an open palm, there is a beginning here — still small, but unmistakable.
1.shortLine: A new possibility shows itself for the first time.
1.uprightLine: Upright points you to accept the beginning and plant the small signal into the real world.
1.reversedLine: Reversed says the possibility is there but the soil is not level yet — check your preparation and your timing.
1.loveLine: A new feeling is only just forming, so it is better to keep that fresh sincerity than to hurry it.
1.relationshipLine: In relationships, the first offer, the first conversation, the heart opening for the first time — these are what matter.
1.careerLine: In work, it is time to test the first spark of an idea on a small scale.
1.moneyLine: In money, the seed of a new income or a small plan is visible, but it is early to settle anything large.
1.growthLine: Within, the strength grows to hold a first-risen wish instead of laughing it off.
1.question: What first seed could I plant, in a small way, today?

2.scene: Two forces look at each other, quietly asking which way things will lean.
2.shortLine: The balance between the two, and the first tuning of it, is the heart of this.
2.uprightLine: Upright says to compare the differing possibilities and find the balance quietly.
2.reversedLine: Reversed lights the scene where the choice is put off, or leans one way, and the flow turns unsteady.
2.loveLine: In love, the first agreement that matches your paces and your hearts is what matters.
2.relationshipLine: In relationships, look at the balance of giving and receiving, and the ratio of silence to speech.
2.careerLine: In work, you need negotiation, comparison, and a decision about priorities.
2.moneyLine: In money, the balance between income and spending, between safety and risk, needs setting again.
2.growthLine: Within, the practice opens of hearing both sides of your heart without swinging to an extreme.
2.question: What two feelings do I need to tune to each other right now?

3.scene: What was held alone comes into view and gets ready to meet other people.
3.shortLine: A hidden current unfolds outward and widens.
3.uprightLine: Upright says it is fine to express, to connect, and to widen into the next stage.
3.reversedLine: Reversed points out that what has come into view needs tidying, so it does not drift into misreading or scattering.
3.loveLine: In love, the feeling starts to show on the outside, and the mood around you has its say too.
3.relationshipLine: In relationships, share and celebrate together — or be careful of a third party's gaze.
3.careerLine: In work, this suits collaboration, presenting, and checking how the market responds.
3.moneyLine: In money, the room for income widens, but the spending can grow along with it.
3.growthLine: Within, the courage grows to show a little more of your story to the world.
3.question: What feeling or finished thing of mine should I be showing more healthily?

4.scene: The flow pauses a moment, and it shows whether the foundation you have built feels restful or stifling.
4.shortLine: Between stability and stagnation, you set your measure again.
4.uprightLine: Upright says you need time to rest a while and firm up your measure.
4.reversedLine: Reversed lights the drift where rest becomes closing off, or stability hardens into stubbornness.
4.loveLine: In love, you want a settled feeling, but the expressing of feeling can thin out.
4.relationshipLine: In relationships, look at each person's space and the habits that keep repeating.
4.careerLine: In work, regrouping, building systems, and recovering your routine all serve you.
4.moneyLine: In money, your power to hold on is strong, but guarding too hard can block an opening.
4.growthLine: Within, you learn the feeling that resting will not make you fall apart.
4.question: What have I been calling stability when it has actually become stagnation?

5.scene: A scene of lack or collision comes into view, showing what the heart feels it has lost.
5.shortLine: Through lack and collision, you come to see what is truly needed.
5.uprightLine: Upright says to face the conflict and the lack you have wanted to avoid.
5.reversedLine: Reversed shows that recovery is possible after the wound, but warns you not to repeat the same pattern.
5.loveLine: In love, hurt feelings, rivalry, and a bruised pride can all rise up.
5.relationshipLine: In relationships, look at what got hurt rather than at who won.
5.careerLine: In work, the measure you need to learn shows itself inside the competition, the loss, the clash of opinion.
5.moneyLine: In money, look at the sense of lack, or at spending you did not expect.
5.growthLine: Within, you come to read lack not as failure but as a signal for the care you need.
5.question: What real need is hiding behind the thing I feel I have lost?

6.scene: Warmth returns after the wound, and the balance between the heart that gives and the heart that receives is put to the test.
6.shortLine: Through giving and receiving, the temperature of the bond and of the heart is restored.
6.uprightLine: Upright says the flow recovers gently as help is given or received.
6.reversedLine: Reversed lights the scene where the exchange tilts one way and turns into burden or dependence.
6.loveLine: In love, tender memories and consideration are what warm the bond.
6.relationshipLine: In relationships, help, an apology, a gift, a small act of care — these carry great weight.
6.careerLine: In work, mentoring, cooperation and supportive ties are what help the results along.
6.moneyLine: In money, gifts, support and settling up come to the surface, and a fair measure is needed.
6.growthLine: Within, you learn that receiving help is a grown-up kind of courage too.
6.question: What am I willing to give right now, and what should I let myself receive?

7.scene: Many possibilities are laid out ahead, and the heart is quietly tested on what to keep and what to choose.
7.shortLine: The more options there are, the more your measure matters.
7.uprightLine: Upright says to look widely at the possibilities, but to check them against your own measure.
7.reversedLine: Reversed lights the state where illusion or unease blurs the measure you choose by.
7.loveLine: In love, you have to tell the real feeling apart from the many feelings and possibilities around it.
7.relationshipLine: In relationships, you need an honest measure so that guardedness and hesitation do not keep repeating.
7.careerLine: In work, comparing options, checking the strategy and setting priorities are what matter.
7.moneyLine: In money, the more choices there are to invest or spend, the more verifying you need.
7.growthLine: Within, you come to set the measure your own soul will keep, not somebody else's.
7.question: Among all these options, what measure does my heart actually want to keep?

8.scene: The energy that has been circling the same spot begins to move, or a signal comes to break the loop.
8.shortLine: You notice the loop and actually set the flow moving.
8.uprightLine: Upright speaks of speed and travel, of practice through repetition, or of the strength to leave a familiar spot.
8.reversedLine: Reversed lights the state of wanting to move while the heart stays behind, so you spin in place.
8.loveLine: In love, the messages, the meetings, the flow of the bond can quicken — or you may leave a familiar pattern.
8.relationshipLine: In relationships, stop repeating the same words and change the actual behaviour.
8.careerLine: In work, quick execution, repeated practice, movement and switching are what matter.
8.moneyLine: In money, break the spending pattern or check the income flow quickly.
8.growthLine: Within, the strength grows to carry into your body what you had only known in your head.
8.question: What change do I already know about but still have not put into action?

9.scene: The heart and the experience built up over a long time have come close to complete, but a last check is needed.
9.shortLine: You confirm, alone and quietly, what everything you have built means.
9.uprightLine: Upright says to acknowledge what has accumulated so far and prepare the final tidying.
9.reversedLine: Reversed lights the scene where holding out alone runs long, and unease or exhaustion grows.
9.loveLine: In love, hopes or worries carried alone can swell, so an honest check is needed.
9.relationshipLine: In relationships, respect each other's inner life, but do not let it harden into isolation.
9.careerLine: In work, mastery, the check before finishing, and personal results all come to the surface.
9.moneyLine: In money, savings and reward are in view, but unease can drift into guarding too hard.
9.growthLine: Within, you learn to acknowledge the self that held on this far, and to let the last of the tension go.
9.question: What part of this may I allow myself to call done well enough?

10.scene: A cycle reaches its end, and both the achievement and the weight of it come into your hands at once.
10.shortLine: Take in the harvest, but look at how its weight is to be shared.
10.uprightLine: Upright speaks of a current bearing fruit and completing, and points you to accept the result in practical terms.
10.reversedLine: Reversed says to stop carrying alone the burden just before completion, or the ending you keep putting off.
10.loveLine: In love, a cycle of the bond may ripen, or the responsibility in it may grow.
10.relationshipLine: In relationships, sort out the feelings and roles that have piled up over time and hand them to the next stage.
10.careerLine: In work, finishing the project, the results, and an overweight responsibility all show up together.
10.moneyLine: In money, the result shows, but a large burden or long-term spending needs checking alongside it.
10.growthLine: Within, you come to learn how to end things and how to share responsibility.
10.question: What weight do I need to set down or share in order to finish this?

11.scene: As a young messenger arrives with fresh news, a signal comes in — still clumsy, but something you can learn from.
11.shortLine: A clumsy start and a willingness to learn are what open the way.
11.uprightLine: Upright says to begin carefully, following the new message, the learning, the curiosity.
11.reversedLine: Reversed lights how unpractised words or a lack of preparation can invite misreading.
11.loveLine: In love, a clumsy show of fondness or a cautious message comes to the surface.
11.relationshipLine: In relationships, a willingness to learn matters more than perfect words.
11.careerLine: In work, a beginner's mind, study, a first draft of a proposal, small tasks — these carry the meaning.
11.moneyLine: In money, small earnings or study come first; build experience rather than making a large decision.
11.growthLine: Within, the permission grows that it is all right to be clumsy.
11.question: What do I need to learn again with a beginner's mind?

12.scene: The knight rides forward, about to actually leave the place the heart had been resting in.
12.shortLine: The energy begins to move in a direction that has been set.
12.uprightLine: Upright points to the drive that moves a situation, and to stepping forward actively.
12.reversedLine: Reversed says the speed and the purpose have come apart, so a collision or spinning in place may follow.
12.loveLine: In love, active messages and meetings, and a step forward in feeling, come into view.
12.relationshipLine: In relationships, move — but keep an eye on the other person's pace as you do.
12.careerLine: In work, execution, movement, going out to meet people, and taking on a challenge are what matter.
12.moneyLine: In money, what you need is a plan with direction, not a hunger for quick returns.
12.growthLine: Within, the courage grows to move your body toward what you want.
12.question: Which direction should I be moving in right now?

13.scene: The queen keeps her own domain, and within it handles feeling and power with maturity.
13.shortLine: The power to hold and a matured sense of things are what steady the flow.
13.uprightLine: Upright points to the matured power that holds a situation gently and handles it.
13.reversedLine: Reversed lights the scene where accepting goes too far and drains you, or the guard grows thick.
13.loveLine: In love, deep understanding and tender protection are what matter.
13.relationshipLine: In relationships, you need the balance of keeping your own inner domain while still holding another.
13.careerLine: In work, management, care, creative leadership and steady coordination are strong.
13.moneyLine: In money, a sense for daily life and the ability to manage lead into stability.
13.growthLine: Within, you learn both the power to hold yourself and the power to guard yourself.
13.question: What is mine to hold, and where is the boundary that is mine to keep?

14.scene: From the seat of responsibility for his own kingdom, the king chooses how his power will be used.
14.shortLine: Practised power and a responsible measure are what put the situation in order.
14.uprightLine: Upright says you can lead the flow on the strength of experience and responsibility.
14.reversedLine: Reversed points you to take care that command does not turn into stubbornness or pressure.
14.loveLine: In love, a responsible manner and consistency are what build trust.
14.relationshipLine: In relationships, speak from a matured measure rather than being swung about by feeling.
14.careerLine: In work, leadership, the power to decide, expertise and the ability to manage all shine.
14.moneyLine: In money, a long-range strategy and management with principles are what matter.
14.growthLine: Within, you learn to use your power responsibly instead of abusing it.
14.question: What power of mine do I need to handle more responsibly?

major_00_fool.shortSummary: A card of the heart drawing its first breath before a road that has no name yet.
major_00_fool.storyTitle: The first step at the threshold
major_00_fool.story: The Fool stands at the cliff's edge, yet those eyes look to the sky before the fall. This card does not speak only of recklessness. It lights the moment when the aliveness you missed while calculating too long waves at you again. So long as you do not forget that the small bundle in your hand is all you carry, the first step is both an adventure and a blessing.
major_00_fool.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Fool points to a time when beginning is fine. Even with the conditions imperfect, taking a small step toward whatever makes your heart come alive opens the flow.
major_00_fool.reversedMeaning: Reversed, the Fool lights a rush without preparation, or a choice that puts responsibility off. However great the excitement, set a safe boundary and check the facts first.
major_00_fool.loveMeaning: In love, a new pull, a first confession, a light flutter come to the surface. Possibility still outweighs promise here, so watch the other person's pace as well.
major_00_fool.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, there is a chance to see each other anew. Set the old roles down and talk as though you had just met — the air in the room changes.
major_00_fool.careerMeaning: In work, a new project, an attempt at moving jobs, the start of learning all suit this. Rather than hiding your inexperience, a willingness to learn is what opens the way.
major_00_fool.moneyMeaning: In money, be careful of spending on impulse and of optimistic arithmetic. Experiment inside a small budget and what remains is experience rather than loss.
major_00_fool.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need time to recover curiosity ahead of fear. Even before you find the perfect answer, the body may already know the next road.
major_00_fool.yeoniMessage: Before this card, let me push the cup a little closer to you. It is all right to be afraid — a first step is meant to tremble a little.
major_00_fool.journalQuestion: What small thing would I like to begin even without perfect certainty?

major_01_magician.shortSummary: A card of the focus that turns the materials in your hand into the language of the real.
major_01_magician.storyTitle: Four tools laid on the table
major_01_magician.story: On the Magician's table lie the wand, the cup, the sword and the pentacle, all of them. It is the scene of being ready to carry a thought that came down from the sky into action here on the ground. This card does not mean waiting for a miracle; it shows itself as a gentle invitation to use precisely what you already hold.
major_01_magician.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Magician points to being able to move the situation with words, skill and focus. Now is the time to bind scattered possibility into a single action.
major_01_magician.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a current of overstating your talent or spending it without direction. When word and deed differ, trust thins — so make your promises smaller.
major_01_magician.loveMeaning: In love, the art of showing charm and of confessing comes alive. But if the staging runs ahead of the sincerity, the other person will sense it keenly.
major_01_magician.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, you have the power to design the conversation and undo a misreading. Do not put off the words that need saying; deliver them in clear sentences.
major_01_magician.careerMeaning: In work, this is strong at planning, presenting, negotiating and the opening stage. Put the tools you have in order and the results show sooner than you expect.
major_01_magician.moneyMeaning: In money, this is the current that turns talent into a structure that earns. A sustainable proposal and a clear price standard matter more than short-term overstatement.
major_01_magician.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need practice in acknowledging the power you hold. Humility is not making yourself small; it is the attitude of using your tools precisely.
major_01_magician.yeoniMessage: You already hold quite a few of the materials you need. Today, I hope you will pick just one of them and set it down on the real world.
major_01_magician.journalQuestion: Which of my abilities have I not yet carried into actual action?

major_02_high_priestess.shortSummary: A card that lights the unspoken layers of the heart and a quiet intuition.
major_02_high_priestess.storyTitle: Water heard behind a closed veil
major_02_high_priestess.story: The High Priestess does not throw the door open. Instead, like water heard from behind a veil, she keeps a truth that has not yet become words. This card points you to watch the feeling that repeats inside the silence, rather than to press for answers.
major_02_high_priestess.uprightMeaning: Upright, the High Priestess marks a time when intuition and observation open the answer. The mood, the spacing, the signal that keeps repeating matter more than the words on the surface.
major_02_high_priestess.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a state of mistaking guesswork for intuition. A secret may be shaken, so do not pass along what has not been verified.
major_02_high_priestess.loveMeaning: In love, the inner heart, the waiting, a careful fondness come to the surface. Leave a margin rather than pressing the other person, and the sincerity rises on its own.
major_02_high_priestess.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, unspoken feeling has piled up. Rather than concluding straight away, look at why the silence came about.
major_02_high_priestess.careerMeaning: In work, this is strong at research, analysis and preparation kept out of sight. Mistakes drop when you read the material and the context that are not on display.
major_02_high_priestess.moneyMeaning: In money, look at the hidden terms rather than the visible return. Check the small sentences in the contract and the promises left pending.
major_02_high_priestess.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the balance of trusting your senses while still verifying them. Silence can be time spent listening deeply rather than avoidance.
major_02_high_priestess.yeoniMessage: I will not press you for an answer just now. Listen quietly instead to the feeling that has already repeated itself in you more than once.
major_02_high_priestess.journalQuestion: What signal is hard to put into words yet keeps staying with me?

major_03_empress.shortSummary: A card of abundance that returns a warm life force to both the heart and the world.
major_03_empress.storyTitle: The soft place where flowers grow
major_03_empress.story: The Empress's garden does not hurry, yet it grows without pause. She waters it, lets the sunlight in, and makes a place where living things can bloom of their own accord. This card says that love and creativity open out of a rhythm of good tending, not out of a force that hauls them up.
major_03_empress.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Empress marks a time when relationships, creative work and daily life all grow fuller. An attitude of tending and accepting is what raises the situation gently.
major_03_empress.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights the scene where tending drifts into dependence or interference. Love is not a reason to blur the boundary between yourself and another.
major_03_empress.loveMeaning: In love, showing affection, touch, and the room for the bond to grow are all strong. Show that warm attention as actual action and the heart opens.
major_03_empress.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, the power to feed each other and let each other rest is what matters. But if only one person keeps doing the tending, the balance needs setting again.
major_03_empress.careerMeaning: In work, creative making, branding, care and an eye for beauty all come alive. Results grow larger when you build the conditions for growth rather than hurry the outcome.
major_03_empress.moneyMeaning: In money, there is a current of abundance, but emotional spending can rise alongside it. Set the line between pleasure and waste, gently.
major_03_empress.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the way you tend your own body and heart becomes the vessel your luck sits in. Habits that are kind to yourself lead into stability in the world.
major_03_empress.yeoniMessage: This card recommends a slightly kinder way of living. A heart is like a plant — it blooms first where it has been tended often.
major_03_empress.journalQuestion: Which area of my life needs tending more warmly?

major_04_emperor.shortSummary: A card that raises a practical pillar over a wavering heart.
major_04_emperor.storyTitle: A throne of stone and a clear boundary
major_04_emperor.story: The Emperor sits on a throne of stone rather than in a flower bed. There is less warmth in it, but it holds the structure and the measure that keep things from collapsing. This card points you to protect with responsibility, promise and boundary what feeling alone cannot keep.
major_04_emperor.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Emperor says stability comes when you set a measure and move responsibly. It is time to turn a loose plan into a concrete structure.
major_04_emperor.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights the urge to control, the stubbornness, the excess rigidity. Look at whether a strong stance has stopped being protection and become pressure.
major_04_emperor.loveMeaning: In love, defining the relationship, the promise, the responsibility all come to matter. A serious heart shows in steady conduct rather than in words.
major_04_emperor.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, roles and boundaries need to be made clear. Reduce the vague expectations and trust actually becomes more comfortable.
major_04_emperor.careerMeaning: In work, this is strong at management, leadership and organizing. Set a measure and decide the priorities, and the scattered work falls into order.
major_04_emperor.moneyMeaning: In money, look at the budget, the long-range plan, the steady assets. Regular management guards your luck better than acting on impulse.
major_04_emperor.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the power to make rules that guard you. Freedom sometimes widens on top of a good boundary.
major_04_emperor.yeoniMessage: Today I would like to set a firm saucer under your cup. Even a wavering heart spills less when there is something holding it up.
major_04_emperor.journalQuestion: What measure do I need to set now, for the sake of what I want to protect?

major_05_hierophant.shortSummary: A card of going to find long-tested wisdom and counsel you can rely on.
major_05_hierophant.storyTitle: A low voice at an old door
major_05_hierophant.story: The Hierophant teaches the meaning of the road long travelled rather than the new and splendid one. In the order, the promises and the rites that someone lived through first and left behind, there is a power that holds a heart steady. Only, tradition is warmest when it exists for living people.
major_05_hierophant.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Hierophant marks a time when the road is set in order through counsel, study, institutions and promises. Refer to a measure you can trust rather than judging alone.
major_05_hierophant.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a rule with nothing left but its form, or being shut inside someone else's measure. Do not hold on to an answer that does not fit you out of politeness.
major_05_hierophant.loveMeaning: In love, a serious meeting, an introduction, making the relationship official come to the surface. You need a conversation that checks whether your values and ways of living match.
major_05_hierophant.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, trust and courtesy sit at the centre. Only, find the promise that fits the two of you rather than the shape other people decided on.
major_05_hierophant.careerMeaning: In work, a mentor, a qualification, training and the organization's rules all matter. Learn the basics solidly and the next stage steadies.
major_05_hierophant.moneyMeaning: In money, tested methods and expert counsel serve you. Avoid products you do not understand and spending that runs on habit.
major_05_hierophant.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need time to question again the principles you believe in. Find the point where old wisdom meets the truth of your own heart.
major_05_hierophant.yeoniMessage: The words you need may not be very new ones. Wisdom that has held out a long while will sound kinder today.
major_05_hierophant.journalQuestion: What principle can I trust and follow right now?

major_06_lovers.shortSummary: A card of relationship, where the pull of the heart meets the choice you actually make.
major_06_lovers.storyTitle: The light toward each other, and the shade of choosing
major_06_lovers.story: The Lovers does not end at saying love has arrived. In the moment two people face each other, their values and their choices come into view as well. This card blesses the pull, and at the same time asks quietly what kind of life that love will have you choose.
major_06_lovers.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Lovers points to the chance that heart and choice will come into harmony. The flow clears when you stop hiding your sincerity and check the values that matter together.
major_06_lovers.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a state where the pull is there but the measures do not line up. Look at whether this is a choice you can carry for a long while, not just a feeling of the moment.
major_06_lovers.loveMeaning: In love, a strong fondness, a confession, a choice about the relationship come to the surface. Look not only at whether they are a good person, but at whether a love that is like you is possible here.
major_06_lovers.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, agreement and honesty matter. The balance returns when you take up the subject you have been avoiding — kindly, but clearly.
major_06_lovers.careerMeaning: In work, the choice of partnership, contract and joint effort matters. Who you do it with changes the colour of the result a great deal.
major_06_lovers.moneyMeaning: In money, check shared finances, contract terms and what you value in spending. Even an offer that looks good should be measured against your own standard.
major_06_lovers.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the courage to admit what you truly want. Let the values of your own heart lead the choice, rather than other people's expectations.
major_06_lovers.yeoniMessage: Love is a sweet feeling, yes — but it is also a door that asks what kind of person you want to become.
major_06_lovers.journalQuestion: How closely does the relationship or road I am about to choose touch my own values?

major_07_chariot.shortSummary: A card of binding wavering forces into a single direction and moving forward.
major_07_chariot.storyTitle: The road drawn by two sphinxes
major_07_chariot.story: The two forces before the Chariot look in different directions. Yet the driver holds the road by will rather than by the reins. This card shows that even with feeling and reality, fear and desire all present at once, you can move once the direction is set.
major_07_chariot.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Chariot points to being able to break through obstacles once you make the goal clear and drive. What is needed now is focus rather than hesitation.
major_07_chariot.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a state where the speed is high but the direction is blurred. Push too hard and people and circumstances may collide.
major_07_chariot.loveMeaning: In love, there is room for an active approach and for the bond to move forward. But ignore the other person's pace and it becomes pressure rather than victory.
major_07_chariot.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, you need the attitude of not avoiding the problem but crossing it together. Advancing only means something when the destination is shared.
major_07_chariot.careerMeaning: In work, this is strong at competition, hitting a target, an examination, seeing a project through. Name who is responsible and manage the pace, and results follow.
major_07_chariot.moneyMeaning: In money, management with a direction — saving toward a target, clearing a debt — serves you. Expanding on impulse can invite an accident.
major_07_chariot.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need practice in gathering a scattered heart into one direction. It is not about doing away with feeling; it is about taking the wheel.
major_07_chariot.yeoniMessage: A wavering heart today does not mean stop. So long as the one direction you take hold of is clear, the chariot can move.
major_07_chariot.journalQuestion: What is the single goal I should gather my strength and advance toward right now?

major_08_strength.shortSummary: A card of the real courage that gentles rather than presses down hard.
major_08_strength.storyTitle: A hand laid at the lion's mouth
major_08_strength.story: Strength is not the scene of defeating the lion but of breathing in time with it. It holds the wisdom of handling the rough impulses and fears inside you by stroking them slowly, rather than driving them into a corner as enemies. Here it becomes plain that gentleness is not weakness.
major_08_strength.uprightMeaning: Upright, Strength says patience and a kind courage are what steady the situation. The way opens when you face it steadily rather than subduing it in haste.
major_08_strength.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights confidence sinking, or exhaustion from holding feeling down. Give yourself room to recover before you push yourself harder.
major_08_strength.loveMeaning: In love, waiting, restoring trust and approaching gently are what matter. A steady manner opens the other person's heart better than a strong assertion.
major_08_strength.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, you need the maturity to handle each other's rough edges of feeling. A conversation that soothes travels further than one that tries to win.
major_08_strength.careerMeaning: In work, this is strong at the long game, managing people, staying calm inside a crisis. Steadiness is what ends up being recognized as ability.
major_08_strength.moneyMeaning: In money, you need management you can keep up for a long time, not a hunger to settle it all at a stroke. Small restraint leads into large stability.
major_08_strength.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need time to make peace with the frightened part inside you. Even a feeling you have held down becomes strength once you speak to it.
major_08_strength.yeoniMessage: You do not have to scold the lion inside you. Today, I hope you will just sit beside it quietly and match its breathing.
major_08_strength.journalQuestion: Which feeling should I gentle with kindness rather than hold down?

major_09_hermit.shortSummary: A card of turning down the noise outside and walking by the lamp within.
major_09_hermit.storyTitle: A small lamp on a snowy road
major_09_hermit.story: The Hermit chooses one quiet lamp over the applause of a crowd. It does not light the whole road ahead, but it lights enough for the next footfall. This card says that time spent alone can be a room for recovering the truth, not only loneliness.
major_09_hermit.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Hermit is a time to step back a while and look deeply. The wisdom your own experience has gathered matters more than an answer from outside.
major_09_hermit.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights reflection turning into isolation, or analysis stretching on without end. You need to connect with someone you can trust.
major_09_hermit.loveMeaning: In love, slow the pace and check your heart. Time to sort things out alone can make the relationship clearer.
major_09_hermit.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, some distance may be needed. But say politely that you need time to think, rather than punishing with silence.
major_09_hermit.careerMeaning: In work, research, review and deepening your expertise all serve you. The knowledge you build now becomes a guide later.
major_09_hermit.moneyMeaning: In money, you need records and review rather than investing on impulse. If judging alone is hard, gather enough material first.
major_09_hermit.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the power to look at yourself without outside approval grows. Quiet time restores your sense of direction.
major_09_hermit.yeoniMessage: Rather than turning the lamp up bright, let me set it close to your feet. Today it is enough to see just the next step.
major_09_hermit.journalQuestion: If I turned down the noise outside right now, what answer would I hear from within?

major_10_wheel_of_fortune.shortSummary: A card where a flow that seemed to have stopped moves again and opens a new phase.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.storyTitle: The turning wheel and the moment that opens
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.story: The Wheel of Fortune does not stay in the same place for anyone. Rising or falling, the wheel keeps turning toward the next scene. This card tells you that even inside change you cannot control, there is a timing and an attitude you can take hold of.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Wheel points to a turn in the flow and an opportunity you did not expect. Ride the change flexibly when it comes and the road widens.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights the same pattern repeating, or the timing slipping out of line. Read the cause of the repetition rather than forcing it along.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.loveMeaning: In love, a chance meeting, a turn in the phase of the bond, an unexpected message come to the surface. But what matters is your attitude after the change, not leaning on luck.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, something arises that changes the flow. If the old way no longer fits, take on a new rhythm.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.careerMeaning: In work, an opportunity, a move between teams, a shift in the market all have their effect. For someone prepared, chance becomes a door.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.moneyMeaning: In money, the swings are large. Even when an opportunity shows, set aside an emergency fund and a risk standard, or the wheel carries you off.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the strength to accept that life does not stay in the same season forever.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.yeoniMessage: When the wheel of fortune turns, your task is not to hold on to everything. It is enough to tell apart what to let go of and what to ride.
major_10_wheel_of_fortune.journalQuestion: What attitude would it take, right now, to change one pattern that keeps repeating in my life?

major_11_justice.shortSummary: A card of setting feeling and fact on the same scale and looking at them honestly.
major_11_justice.storyTitle: The stillness between sword and scale
major_11_justice.story: The scale of Justice does not ignore the heart, but it does not reach a conclusion on the heart alone either. The sword keeps you from deferring a decision that must be made; the scale asks whether that decision is fair. In the end this card tells you to look at the responsibility for what you chose, as well.
major_11_justice.uprightMeaning: Upright, Justice points to checking the facts, judging fairly, concluding responsibly. It is time to reduce the vagueness and set a measure.
major_11_justice.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a judgement tilted to one side, or responsibility dodged. If there is a grievance, separate the feeling from the evidence and set it in order.
major_11_justice.loveMeaning: In love, fairness in the bond and responsibility on both sides matter. Consistency in behaviour shows sincerity better than feeling does.
major_11_justice.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, name precisely the lopsided roles and the hurt that keeps repeating. What is fair matters more than who is right.
major_11_justice.careerMeaning: In work, contracts, appraisals, legal documents and compliance all matter. Leave a record and move according to the standard.
major_11_justice.moneyMeaning: In money, look carefully at settlements, contracts, debts and tax matters. A vague promise becomes a burden later.
major_11_justice.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the maturity to accept the results of your own choices. Honesty is sometimes the largest healing there is.
major_11_justice.yeoniMessage: I would like to take your side, but this card shows the scale first. Set the feeling and the fact on it together, and the road appears.
major_11_justice.journalQuestion: What fact do I need to look at fairly right now?

major_12_hanged_man.shortSummary: A card where, inside time that will not move, the view opens upside down.
major_12_hanged_man.storyTitle: The other sky of one hanging upside down
major_12_hanged_man.story: The Hanged Man is bound, yet the face is surprisingly calm. In the moment the world looks upside down, a road unknown before comes into sight. This card shows that a delay may be an invitation to change your view, not a punishment.
major_12_hanged_man.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Hanged Man says to stop a while and take another view. The problem looks new when you let go, rather than force it loose.
major_12_hanged_man.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights waiting that has become a draining sacrifice rather than meaningful reflection. Ask again why you are standing still.
major_12_hanged_man.loveMeaning: In love, the more you hurry the more it tangles. Time spent looking from the other person's side loosens the tension in the bond.
major_12_hanged_man.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, look at the balance between yielding and sacrifice. If only one person is left hanging, that is not love but depletion.
major_12_hanged_man.careerMeaning: In work, you need to hold off, review again, change direction. Even if results are slow just now, change the view and a solution appears.
major_12_hanged_man.moneyMeaning: In money, this can mean tied-up funds, delayed returns, a contract on hold. Reviewing the terms comes before forcing a recovery.
major_12_hanged_man.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the wisdom of letting go grows larger. When the hand that grips everything opens, the heart sees a new meaning.
major_12_hanged_man.yeoniMessage: The time that stopped has not abandoned you. Look at it upside down for a moment, and you may see the road your heart missed.
major_12_hanged_man.journalQuestion: What problem do I need to look at from another angle right now?

major_13_death.shortSummary: A card that, under the name of an ending, sheds the old shell and prepares a new form.
major_13_death.storyTitle: The fading field and the dawn that rises again
major_13_death.story: The Death card speaks of a deep change rather than a terrifying finale. A way of living that can no longer protect you quietly lowers its curtain, and a new order, still unfamiliar, takes its place. Even when the ending hurts, this card shows that life keeps flowing by changing its form.
major_13_death.uprightMeaning: Upright, Death points to clearing away a current you have held on to for long and moving to a new stage. The more you admit the ending, the faster the rebirth.
major_13_death.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a state where the heart cannot release what has already ended, so change is delayed. Tell apart whether the attachment protects you or binds you.
major_13_death.loveMeaning: In love, a large turn in the bond, sorting yourself out after a parting, the end of an old pattern come to the surface. Only by ending it does the strength to love again return.
major_13_death.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, the old way may no longer work. Without an honest change, the same wound repeats.
major_13_death.careerMeaning: In work, a change of role, the close of a project, a move into a new structure are all strong. Clear away what needs clearing and the next offer comes in.
major_13_death.moneyMeaning: In money, you need to settle losses, rebuild how you spend, end a long-standing burden. The feeling that it is a waste can create a larger loss.
major_13_death.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, a time opens for taking off the name that has long defined you. In the place of loss, a truer self can grow.
major_13_death.yeoniMessage: This card does not speak only of endings. It speaks of the moment when a heart held on to for long is finally about to breathe in another form.
major_13_death.journalQuestion: What must I let go of before I can cross into the next season?

major_14_temperance.shortSummary: A card of blending different streams slowly until they reach the temperature of healing.
major_14_temperance.storyTitle: The light flowing between two cups
major_14_temperance.story: The angel of Temperance moves the water from one cup to the other without hurry. Finding the temperature that is neither too hot nor too cold — that is the wisdom of this card. A heart and a reality that have split apart can also make a new balance if they are blended slowly.
major_14_temperance.uprightMeaning: Upright, Temperance is a current of attunement and recovery. Keep from the extremes and match the pace, and the situation settles gently.
major_14_temperance.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights excess, imbalance, the urge to fix things too fast. A life and a feeling tilted to one side need blending again.
major_14_temperance.loveMeaning: In love, the time spent matching two different natures matters. Look for a rhythm that will last, rather than a hot feeling.
major_14_temperance.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, mediation, reconciliation and adjusting the rhythm of daily life are needed. A small kindness melts a large conflict.
major_14_temperance.careerMeaning: In work, coordinating with others, managing the schedule and balancing several roles all matter. A sustainable pace produces more than a forced one.
major_14_temperance.moneyMeaning: In money, restore the balance between spending and saving. Daily adjustment leads to stability better than one large change.
major_14_temperance.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, a time opens to reconcile the two extremes of yourself. Even opposing feelings become wisdom when blended well.
major_14_temperance.yeoniMessage: Let me cool your tea a little today. What you need now is a moderate temperature, not a scalding conclusion.
major_14_temperance.journalQuestion: Which area of my life needs its temperature adjusted again right now?

major_15_devil.shortSummary: A card of looking honestly at the loop of desire and fear that binds you.
major_15_devil.storyTitle: The fact that the chain is loose
major_15_devil.story: The chains on the Devil card are looser than they look. Yet the one bound believes they cannot free themselves, because the fear has grown familiar over long years. This card does not simply call the desire pulling at you bad; it tells you to look at where it came from.
major_15_devil.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Devil lights obsession, addictive patterns, worldly desire. Look at the shadow you would not admit, and the power to choose comes back to you.
major_15_devil.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a current where you become aware of the bondage and get ready to leave it. Break the repetition, even a little, and the sense of freedom revives.
major_15_devil.loveMeaning: In love, a strong pull, jealousy, dependence, a secret bond may surface. Do not confuse desire with affection.
major_15_devil.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, look at the pattern that binds you to each other. A bond held together by guilt or control needs room to breathe.
major_15_devil.careerMeaning: In work, power, ambition and the pressure to perform run strong. Check whether the goal is growing you or draining you.
major_15_devil.moneyMeaning: In money, be careful of debt, overspending, and purchases that feed desire. Look at the numbers honestly and the first clue to release appears.
major_15_devil.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, you need the courage not to deny your own shadow. The moment you see the binding, the chain has already loosened a little.
major_15_devil.yeoniMessage: Let us look slowly together at whether what binds you is truly fate, or a fear that has simply grown familiar.
major_15_devil.journalQuestion: What repeating pattern makes me feel that I am not free?

major_16_tower.shortSummary: A card where an old structure falls and lays bare a truer foundation.
major_16_tower.storyTitle: Beneath the tower the lightning struck
major_16_tower.story: The Tower is most frightening in the moment it falls, yet it had been cracked for a long time. The lightning is less a cruel destroyer than a light that reveals a structure that can no longer hold. This card lets you see, in the rubble, the foundation you truly have to rebuild.
major_16_tower.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Tower points to sudden change and truth laid bare. Even with the shock, an honest rebuilding serves you better than clinging to a false foundation.
major_16_tower.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a state where you try to avoid change while everything inside is already shaking. Ignore the small cracks and a larger reckoning may come.
major_16_tower.loveMeaning: In love, a hidden problem, a sudden confession, the collapse of the bond's structure come to the surface. The chance of recovery appears only when you stop avoiding the truth.
major_16_tower.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, a conflict long covered over may come out. What matters is not rebuilding the broken way of talking exactly as it was.
major_16_tower.careerMeaning: In work, there may be a change in the organisation, a cancelled plan, feedback that lands hard. Admit the reality quickly and build a new structure.
major_16_tower.moneyMeaning: In money, be careful of unexpected costs or exposure to risk. Check your emergency plan, your insurance, the shape of your debt.
major_16_tower.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, an old certainty you have believed in may be shaken. After the fall, there remains room to build a firmer truth.
major_16_tower.yeoniMessage: The tower falling does not mean you fall. What came down may only be a way of living that could no longer protect you.
major_16_tower.journalQuestion: What structure in my life is no longer safe?

major_17_star.shortSummary: A card of hope that pours clear water again, even after the wound.
major_17_star.storyTitle: Two streams poured under the night sky
major_17_star.story: The Star does not command loudly the way the sun does. It stays quietly through the dark night and tells you the direction. This card does not mean the wounds are all gone; it shows that the belief you can grow clear again still remains in your heart.
major_17_star.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Star is a current of healing, inspiration, trust restored. Even without hurrying, the heart turns bit by bit toward the clear side.
major_17_star.reversedMeaning: Reversed lights a state where hope is hard to believe. The light may not have gone; tired eyes may simply be unable to see it for a while.
major_17_star.loveMeaning: In love, recovery after a wound, a pure liking, the wish to believe in the future again come to the surface. A gentle sincerity is what lasts.
major_17_star.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, being a safe space for each other matters. Steady reassurance revives trust better than a grand promise.
major_17_star.careerMeaning: In work, creative inspiration, a long-range vision and a good name all come alive. The sincere work you do now shines later.
major_17_star.moneyMeaning: In money, recovery is possible, but it is closer to long-term stability than to immediate return. Be hopeful, but do not forget the plan.
major_17_star.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the power to believe again grows. You can water the future without denying the wound.
major_17_star.yeoniMessage: However long the night, the star does not disappear. Today it is enough simply not to lose one very small hope.
major_17_star.journalQuestion: What small light of the future would I like to believe in again?

major_18_moon.shortSummary: A card that lights both the shadow of the heart and its instinct, on an uncertain night road.
major_18_moon.storyTitle: The dog and the wolf baying under moonlight
major_18_moon.story: The Moon does not show everything clearly. That is why we sometimes mistake a shadow for a monster. This card does not mean your unease is false; it says carefully that the information is still incomplete, so do not trust a conclusion reached at night as though it were a daylight truth.
major_18_moon.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Moon points to unease, dreams, the unconscious, a situation still vague. What you need now is time to look at where the feeling comes from, not a firm verdict.
major_18_moon.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a current where the confusion clears a little and the outline of the truth begins to show. Put the fear into words and it loses its force.
major_18_moon.loveMeaning: In love, unease, imagination and guesses about what the other person really feels can all grow. Do not wound your heart with a reading you never confirmed.
major_18_moon.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, misunderstanding and hidden feeling run beneath the surface. Until you ask directly, hold back from declaring a shadow to be fact.
major_18_moon.careerMeaning: In work, it means missing information, vague instructions, an uncertain direction. Gather more material, and look again in the morning at what worried you at night.
major_18_moon.moneyMeaning: In money, be careful of a vague offer, or spending that comes out of anxiety. Put off any large decision until the numbers grow clear.
major_18_moon.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, a time opens for listening to the voice of the unconscious. Even inside the fear lies a clue to a feeling long buried.
major_18_moon.yeoniMessage: It is all right to be afraid of the night road. Moonlight may look very small, but it keeps you from losing the way entirely.
major_18_moon.journalQuestion: Among the things I believe to be fact, which is a fear I have not yet confirmed?

major_19_sun.shortSummary: A card where what was hidden brightens and the warmth of living comes back.
major_19_sun.storyTitle: The bright horse beyond the sunflower wall
major_19_sun.story: The Sun sweeps the tangled symbols aside and lights life force just as it is. Like a child laughing on horseback, this card speaks of the moment when living feels simple and bright again. Joy is sometimes the most honest signpost there is.
major_19_sun.uprightMeaning: Upright, the Sun points to clarity, vitality, success, joy shared in the open. What was hidden brightens and confidence returns.
major_19_sun.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a state where joy runs late, or too much optimism makes you miss a small patch of shade. Trust the light, but check the details.
major_19_sun.loveMeaning: In love, there is honest affection, a bright meeting, the chance of making the bond public. Not hiding puts the heart at ease.
major_19_sun.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, misunderstandings loosen and warm exchange revives. Time you can laugh through together becomes the key to recovery.
major_19_sun.careerMeaning: In work, results, recognition, a presentation, visible success come to the surface. It is a good time to show yourself with confidence.
major_19_sun.moneyMeaning: In money, there may be a gain or good news. Just keep the balance so that cheerful spending does not grow too large.
major_19_sun.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the power to show yourself without hiding grows. Receive joy without guilt.
major_19_sun.yeoniMessage: Today this card says you may laugh brightly. There is a place in your heart, too, where sunlight can rest.
major_19_sun.journalQuestion: What side of myself do I want to stop hiding and show brightly?

major_20_judgement.shortSummary: A card where a heart long asleep hears the call and rises again.
major_20_judgement.storyTitle: The trumpet and the opened coffins
major_20_judgement.story: The trumpet of Judgement is less a sound handing down punishment than a call to wake. Past choices and regrets included, the time has come to call your life again from a wider view. Rather than saying the past is over, this card lights the moment when the past is revived with a new meaning.
major_20_judgement.uprightMeaning: Upright, Judgement points to awakening, reappraisal, an important decision. Answer the call you have long deferred and the direction of your life grows clear.
major_20_judgement.reversedMeaning: Reversed is a state of being unable to forgive yourself, or putting the decision off. What is needed is a truthful answer, not perfect preparation.
major_20_judgement.loveMeaning: In love, a reunion, a reckoning of the bond, a checking of true feeling come to the surface. You must choose whether to repeat the past or revive it anew.
major_20_judgement.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, an old story can be brought out again and settled. A responsible confession changes the current better than blame does.
major_20_judgement.careerMeaning: In work, appraisal, interviews, a change of career and a sense of calling all run strong. Make clear the work you truly want to answer.
major_20_judgement.moneyMeaning: In money, settle the accounts of your past financial habits. Handle the overdue settlements and old promises and your heart grows lighter.
major_20_judgement.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, a time opens for turning regret into learning. Do not turn away from the voice calling you back.
major_20_judgement.yeoniMessage: This card wakes you rather than scolds you. It says that now, carrying all that time behind you, you can answer again.
major_20_judgement.journalQuestion: What is the work inside me that keeps calling my name?

major_21_world.shortSummary: A card of completion: one journey integrated, and a step into a wider chapter.
major_21_world.storyTitle: The last scene, dancing inside the laurel wreath
major_21_world.story: The figure on the World card does not stop at the end — it dances. Completion is not a closed door but a rhythm that carries every experience you have passed through into the next circle. This card shows you that it is time to acknowledge what you have learned enough of, and move to a new stage.
major_21_world.uprightMeaning: Upright, the World points to completion, achievement, integration, expansion. The effort so far takes a single shape and opens the next door.
major_21_world.reversedMeaning: Reversed says it is nearly done, but a small loop still waits to be closed. Put off the ending and the same scene repeats.
major_21_world.loveMeaning: In love, a mature conclusion to the bond, long-term stability, a move into a new stage come to the surface. It is time to acknowledge the world you built together.
major_21_world.relationshipMeaning: In relationships, you need time to integrate the meaning of a long journey. Share both thanks and a tidying-up, and the next chapter comes easier.
major_21_world.careerMeaning: In work, there is a current of a project completed, a promotion, a graduation, going abroad or expanding. Get ready to gather your results and show them.
major_21_world.moneyMeaning: In money, the fruit of a long plan or the completion of a financial structure comes into view. The closing settlement and setting the next goal both matter.
major_21_world.innerGrowthMeaning: For inner growth, the power to receive your many pieces as one grows. Even the moments where you fell short were part of the journey.
major_21_world.yeoniMessage: You have come through a great many scenes to reach here. Rather than fearing the ending now, hold the completed rhythm once in your arms.
major_21_world.journalQuestion: What should I now call complete, so that I can move on to the next chapter?

upright.meaning: Not every answer is settled yet, and the heart is catching a light breath before a new road.

reversed.meaning: The energy to begin is there, but the heart may run ahead — small checks and practical preparation come first.

upright.meaning: The resources already in your hands and the power of your words wake up — a time when thought can be moved into reality.

reversed.meaning: The ability is there, but the direction scatters easily — aligning your words with your actions comes first.

upright.meaning: Quiet intuition and a layer of feeling not yet brought to light matter more than anything said out loud.

reversed.meaning: The feeling is strong, but unverified guesses may be mixed in — separate the voice of the heart from the facts.

upright.meaning: Warm care and the power to grow a bond come alive, and the heart slowly recovers steadiness and abundance.

reversed.meaning: The more you want to care for someone, the easier it is to forget yourself — the balance of affection needs setting right again.

upright.meaning: The more feelings shake, the more a clear standard and a responsible choice settle the situation.

reversed.meaning: Gripping too hard can narrow the air to breathe — set the standard, but leave some room.

upright.meaning: Rather than judging alone, trustworthy counsel and a long-standing standard put the road in order.

reversed.meaning: A standard that no longer fits may be holding you — it is time to ask what is truly yours.

upright.meaning: Where the pull of your heart meets the choice you actually make, the grain of an important bond shows itself.

reversed.meaning: There is a difference that fondness alone will not solve — you both need to look at each other's standards more honestly.

upright.meaning: Rather than leaving the hesitation to sit, choosing a direction and moving opens the situation quickly.

reversed.meaning: However much you want speed, a blurred direction brings collisions — straighten the wheel first.

upright.meaning: Rather than pushing hard, the strength to hold gently settles both the heart and the situation.

reversed.meaning: What shows first is a heart worn out from holding on — rather than driving yourself, you need time to recover your strength.

upright.meaning: When you step back a moment and look quietly, an answer that has waited a long time inside shows its face.

reversed.meaning: The deeper the time spent thinking alone, the more it can drift into isolation — open a trustworthy connection a little.

upright.meaning: A flow that had stopped begins to move, and an unforeseen occasion tilts the direction of fate a little.

reversed.meaning: Change is approaching, but the timing is not ripe yet — read the pattern that keeps repeating first.

upright.meaning: When feeling and fact go on the same scale, the standard you need for this choice grows clear.

reversed.meaning: The heart may be tilted to one side and blurring the judgement — set the facts out again, calmly.

upright.meaning: This delay is not a punishment but a sign to change your view — the more you let go, the more the road appears.

reversed.meaning: If the waiting has drifted from meaningful reflection into wear, ask again why you are still holding on.

upright.meaning: The ending flow may look frightening, but it is the turn where a new order opens after the old shell comes off.

reversed.meaning: The heart is holding on to what should already have changed — the longer the clearing is put off, the longer the ache lasts.

upright.meaning: Unhurried attunement becomes the greatest strength, and heart and reality slowly find the same temperature.

reversed.meaning: The temperature of your heart has run too high or too low — slow the pace and set the rhythm again.

upright.meaning: Behind a strong pull hide a binding and a habit that repeats — look at what is really holding you.

reversed.meaning: As you notice the pattern that bound you, the strength to step out of it, little by little, comes.

upright.meaning: The shaking is large, but a hidden truth comes out and tells you that you can no longer stand on the old structure.

reversed.meaning: Even if you try to avoid the big change, the inner cracks are already visible — start with small repairs.

fortuneTpl.animalSame: Today's day-branch is {branch}, the same as this sign's. It is a day of bihwa — the same force doubled — so your usual disposition comes through as it is, only a little stronger. Strengths and habits both grow, so keep pushing what already works and only watch that it does not run to excess.
fortuneTpl.animalClash: Today's day-branch {branch} stands head-on against this sign — a clash. That does not mean an unlucky day; it means a day of wider swings. Travel, messages and plans may not go as scheduled, so leave slack, and a decision carrying emotion usually settles itself if you put it off a day.
fortuneTpl.animalTrine: Today's day-branch {branch} forms a trine with this sign, making {trine}. It is a day whose grain matches the {a1} and the {a2}, so cooperation and asking for things go through easily. A good spot to share out work you have been carrying alone.
fortuneTpl.animalNeutral: Today's day-branch is {branch}, which forms no particular union or clash with this sign. With few outside variables, the day returns results in proportion to your own preparation. A fine day for clearing what you have been putting off.
fortuneTpl.zodiacSunHome: The Sun is resting in {sign} today. With the Sun in your own house, presence and initiative rise, and force gathers behind what you begin. It is the best stretch of the year for putting your own story forward.
fortuneTpl.zodiacMoonHome: The Moon passes through {sign} today. The Moon changes house roughly every two or three days, and on the day it enters your own, feeling turns clear and instinct lands well. A day on which you may trust the way your heart leans.
fortuneTpl.zodiacNeutral: Today the Sun rests in {sun} and the Moon passes through {moon}. For {sign} this is a stretch in which no outside force pulls hard, so pushing on with your own plan works out better than riding a current.
fortuneTpl.zodiacNeutralNoSun: For {sign}, today is a day with little interference from outside forces. Move by your own plan.

0.title: Stars light up in the dark, one by one

0.text:
You can see nothing at all.
Then, as your eyes settle into the dark, stars begin to light up overhead, one by one.

1.text:
The stars were not scattered at random.
One by one they link up, drawing the outline of an enormous book.

1.title: A candle approaches from far off

0.text:
A small light sways on the far side of the dark.
Someone is walking toward you, candlestick in hand.

1.text:
The footsteps stop.
Where the light falls, a bookcase without end comes into view.

0.text:
Shelves that reach the ceiling are packed with countless books.
On every spine, a person's name is engraved.

1.text:
Only one slot stands empty.
It is the place for a book that has not been written yet.

3.eyebrow: Someone who has read people's love lives for decades
3.title: The love master welcomes you

1.text:
Every book here is a record of someone's love.
Things I have read, heard and written down over decades.

2.text:
And yet that one slot is still empty.
Because no one has read your story yet.

4.title: Four Pillars (BaZi) tells what kind of person you are

0.text:
The master unrolls a scroll on the desk.
Only eight characters are written on it — two each for the year, month, day and hour of your birth.

1.text:
This is where your temperament in love comes from.
Whether you reach out first or wait to be reached, whether your feelings cool fast or slowly — the day stem, the Ten Gods and the weight of the Five Elements say it.

5.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu looks at where a person is placed

0.text:
On the second scroll there are no characters, only a circle.
The circle is divided into twelve houses, and a star sits in each one.

1.text:
Life Palace, Spouse Palace, Fortune Palace, Travel Palace — every house has a name.
What kind of person comes to the spouse seat, and which door a bond opens through, is what these houses tell.
1.cta: Lay the two scrolls side by side

6.eyebrow: Why the two charts are laid over each other
6.title: Read only one chart and something is always missed

0.text:
Some people read as reserved in the Four Pillars, and yet their Spouse Palace stands bright on the star chart.
Neither reading is wrong. The two charts are looking at different layers.

1.text:
That is why I always lay the two over each other.
Where they say the same thing, I tell you with confidence; where they diverge, I explain why. One of the twenty chapters is given to this cross-check alone.

2.text:
There is one thing I cannot promise, though.
I do not know any fixed ending. What this book does is show you, with evidence, the patterns you repeat in love — and no further.

7.title: Do you want to know the human heart?

0.text:
Before the book opens, let me ask you one thing.
Do you want to know the human heart?

Then let me begin with your destiny.
I will lay your Four Pillars chart and your Zi Wei Dou Shu chart open together, and go through them slowly across twenty chapters.

0.label: Yes, I want to know.
0.reply: Clear enough. Then I will not begin with comfort. I will start with the evidence.

1.label: I'm not sure yet.
1.reply: Not knowing does not mean there is nothing there. It only means you have not named it yet.

2.label: I want to know about the other person.
2.reply: Then we will talk about them. But in the end it always comes back to you.

3.label: I want to understand myself.
3.reply: You have chosen the answer that takes the longest and lasts the longest. Then we begin with you.

kang-taejun.name: Kang Tae-jun
kang-taejun.profileLine: Quick to show what he feels and never one to hide a mind already made up, yet real love is where he trades winning for running in step with someone — a straight-ahead type.
kang-taejun.bestApproach: Cheering him on honestly and running alongside him works far better than vague push-and-pull. Just don't get swept up in his pace — say out loud when it is time to rest, and it lasts.

kwon-sehyun.name: Kwon Se-hyun
kwon-sehyun.profileLine: He rarely lets emotion show, but once trust has been built he carves out a safe seat for you inside his own schedule — a strategist through and through.
kwon-sehyun.bestApproach: Rather than trying to change him, keep giving the steady impression that you can be trusted. Tidy promises and calm follow-through reach Se-hyun most deeply.

michael.name: Michael
michael.archetype: The Quiet Watcher of the Night
michael.profileLine: He is not easily carried away; he watches the silences between words and quiet trust for a long time, and once he opens his heart he will cross even the dark with you.
michael.bestApproach: Do not mistake his silence for indifference; come close in a quiet way. Instead of pressing for an answer, leave time for the water of his heart to find its own course.

seo-yuan.name: Seo Yu-an
seo-yuan.profileLine: He is grateful for small things and quietly arranges everything so you can relax, yet real love is where he learns that he, too, wants someone to lean on.
seo-yuan.bestApproach: Show your sincerity slowly, in a relaxed atmosphere. Instead of taking his kindness for granted, tell him specifically which piece of care carried you through.

seo-ijun.name: Seo I-jun
seo-ijun.profileLine: He does not come close easily, but a real conversation pulls him hard, and he stays longest beside someone who never trespasses on his solitude — a deep observer.
seo-ijun.bestApproach: Rather than trying to persuade him, build the depth of the conversation together. Do not force certainty on him; leave him both time alone and a place to come back to.

yoon-siwoo.name: Yoon Si-woo
yoon-siwoo.profileLine: Gentle, diligent and kind to everyone, he still knows exactly where the line is; he wants to grow together while protecting the seasons meant for rest.
yoon-siwoo.bestApproach: Start out like an easy friend and let closeness build steadily. Ask about his dreams without grading them, respect his plans, and on tired days tell him it is fine to rest.

han-yunseo.name: Han Yoon-seo
han-yunseo.profileLine: Playful on the surface but wholly serious about music and feeling, he is shaken more deeply by one person's accurate gaze than by any cheering crowd — a free spirit.
han-yunseo.bestApproach: Balancing seriousness and lightness is what matters. Play along with his teasing, but never miss the real feeling hidden inside it.

kim-ming.name: Kim Ming
kim-ming.profileLine: She cares about the grain of a feeling and the mood around it, polishing love into something beautiful with small courtesies and careful certainty.
kim-ming.bestApproach: A careful, sincere manner suits her far better than showy words. More than matching the mood, what matters is the courtesy that makes her feel safe inside it.

park-jieun.name: Park Ji-eun
park-jieun.profileLine: She hides deep, complicated feelings and quietly tests whether your sincerity stays consistent — but once she feels safe, no one stays deeper than she does.
park-jieun.bestApproach: Do not answer her with an emotional fight; set boundaries, but state your sincerity clearly. Hold her anxiety, and gently stop her before testing becomes her way of loving.

saebyeok.name: Saebyeok
saebyeok.archetype: The Red Light of the City
saebyeok.profileLine: She hides a fine-grained sensitivity inside a clear, urban manner, and entrusts her weaker moments only to someone who never tries to break her strength — a woman who leads.
saebyeok.bestApproach: Talk to her clearly and like an adult. Do not compete with her strength; keep showing her, steadily, that you are on the side facing the same direction.

seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon.archetype: A First Love Like Flower Scent
seoyeon.profileLine: A small word or expression is enough to flutter her, yet she blooms fully only before a heart that remembered her for a long time — a first-love type.
seoyeon.bestApproach: Temperature matters more than speed. Keep small promises with warm, steady words, and never rush her rhythm.

soha.name: Sohwa
soha.profileLine: Being with her gives you energy, yet what she dreams of is a bond that keeps breathing with her on the days that are not bright either — an energy mate.
soha.bestApproach: Make plenty of moments where you move and laugh together, but look at her condition before her records, and stay beside her on the days that are not bright.

jiyoon.name: Jiyoon
jiyoon.profileLine: Bright and flexible as the sea, she deepens only with someone who never treats the sincerity inside that ease as something light.
jiyoon.bestApproach: Rather than tying her down, keep the relationship easy and clear-aired while confirming your sincerity in plain words.

harin.name: Harin
harin.profileLine: She opens up on a bouncy, sparkling rhythm, but stays long only with someone who sees the real feeling behind the teasing.
harin.bestApproach: Do not come at her too heavily; get close on a bright, playful rhythm, and do not miss the sincerity tucked inside the jokes.

neo.name: Neo
neo.profileLine: He closes the distance slowly, but he keeps small preferences and promises stored for a long time — a silver observer.
neo.bestApproach: Rather than rushing in, learn his thoughts and tastes slowly. Short questions and a long memory suit him best.

yeoni.name: Yeoni
yeoni.profileLine: She reads the grain of your heart with a soft sensibility, yet she blooms slowly, and only for someone who tends her own wounds as well — a healer.
yeoni.bestApproach: Come closer slowly with soft, sincere words, and do not only expect the comfort she gives; ask after her heart in return.

fateOpen.title: A relationship where destiny's code opened
fateOpen.body: Your hearts met in a fairly natural rhythm. It was not only attraction leading the way; you also created a pace where the other person could feel safe.

slowBond.title: A bond that deepens slowly
slowBond.body: This connection is closer to something that lasts than something that burns quickly. Small gestures and repeated sincerity quietly opened the door between you.

needsTuning.title: A spark that needs gentle tuning
needsTuning.body: There was clear attraction, but your pace and ways of expressing love still need delicate adjustment. A slower check-in will help the feeling last.

learnLanguage.title: A relationship learning each other's language
learnLanguage.body: The heart moved, but your emotional textures were not fully the same. Once you learn how the other person feels loved, the air between you can soften.

needsSpace.title: A relationship that needs distance control
needsSpace.body: This connection asks you to sense distance before emotional temperature. Leave enough space for the other person to breathe instead of rushing closer.
